allocations.selection_reason: Rapid data-center growth and the August earnings catalyst provide the strongest direct exposure to sustained AI-compute demand.
Custom AI accelerators, networking products and VMware cash generation offer multiple drivers ahead of September results.
Accelerating AWS growth and expanding cloud operating profit create room for further earnings-estimate upgrades.
AI clusters require high-speed networking, giving Arista a focused route to benefit from hyperscaler infrastructure spending.
Exceptional cash generation and AI-driven advertising efficiency could produce another material earnings and guidance surprise.
Strong third-quarter guidance and leading-edge manufacturing dominance provide broad exposure to rising AI-chip volumes.

portfolio_thesis: The portfolio concentrates on profitable leaders across the AI investment chain: computing, custom silicon, foundry capacity, networking, cloud deployment and AI-enabled advertising. Different monetization points reduce single-company dependence while preserving high sensitivity to continued AI capital expenditure and earnings revisions.
expected_three_month_driver: Stronger-than-expected earnings, guidance and infrastructure demand across the August-to-October reporting cycle should drive upward analyst revisions and momentum.
biggest_portfolio_risk: A broad valuation compression in AI-related equities, triggered by weaker hyperscaler spending, export restrictions, supply-chain disruption or disappointing forward guidance.
